review.summary: Reviewed the merged upstream change and Joolia context. It only changes synchronization for binding invalidation in src/module.c; no zero-origin adaptation is required. No source or test files were changed, and no builds or tests were run.

commits.subsystems: Native module binding partitions and world-age synchronization in src/module.c (`jl_disable_binding`, `jl_replace_binding_locked`, `jl_get_binding_partition`), with downstream invalidation through base/runtime_internals.jl (`delete_binding`) and Compiler/src/bindinginvalidations.jl.
commits.indexing_implications: The changed `new_world` in src/module.c:2059 is a monotonic world-age/version identifier, not a collection position, dimension selector, or storage index; preserving `jl_atomic_load_relaxed(&jl_world_counter) + 1` is correct. The `new_world - 1` operations in `jl_replace_binding_locked2` are inclusive previous-world bounds for binding partitions and invalidation, not origin conversions. `bpart` is a binding-partition pointer. Surrounding callers in src/toplevel.c, src/module.c (`jl_deprecate_binding`, `jl_module_import`, and `jl_module_using`) use the same lock/new-world protocol. The existing `jl_binding_backedges_getindex` C boundary and Compiler loop remain unchanged; their one-based API argument is an external interface convention and is not affected by this commit.
commits.adaptations: None. The upstream retrying path inspected the binding partition at the current world, then called `jl_replace_binding`; the resulting code instead holds `world_counter_lock`, computes the next world, resolves `bpart` at that new world, replaces it with `jl_replace_binding_locked`, publishes the world, and unlocks. This preserves the binding-partition interval semantics and removes the check/replace race. Joolia's existing zero-origin changes in Compiler/src/bindinginvalidations.jl do not overlap this path, and translating any of these world identifiers would be incorrect.
commits.tests: Recommended, not executed: rebuild the runtime with `make -j`; run `make -C src analyze-module -j8 --output-sync` after analysis dependencies are available; run the existing rebinding and world-age coverage with `./usr/bin/joolia --startup-file=no --check-bounds=yes test/runtests.jl rebinding worlds`; inspect `test/rebinding.jl` cases for `Base.delete_binding`, outdated world ages, guard partitions, and invalidation, plus `test/worlds.jl` monotonic world-counter checks. Then run the required `python3 contrib/ci/run.py --jobs 4` gate, with particular attention to concurrent binding invalidation behavior.
